items.scope: Vivo issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered through independent research conducted by TuranSec to products and projects that are not CNAs themselves.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
LG Electronics products only.
JetBrains products only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Siemens issues only.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
Zyxel products issues only.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
All Gallagher security products only.
Pure Storage products only.
openHarmony issues only.
Eaton issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Digi branded products and services only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Citrix issues only.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
ASR products only.
All Honeywell products.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Third-party products it researches.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.

Vulnerability coordination for vulnerabilities in all products reported to CERT-In in accordance with our vulnerability coordination role as a CERT. Vulnerability assignments for vulnerabilities impacting all products designed, developed, and manufactured in India.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Yugabyte products only.
Bosch products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
